ei.title: 6번: The Color of the Golden Gate Bridge
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: When San Francisco's famous Golden Gate Bridge was being designed in the mid-1930s, the United States Navy proposed colors that would have given the landmark a much different feel. The Navy suggested that it be painted yellow with black stripes to avoid any accidents with ships. However, these colors might well remind people of industrial caution tape. Of course, nobody outside the Navy wanted to paint the bridge with those colors. In the end, architect Irving Morrow decided to use "International Orange," as it was both visible and pleasing to the eye. The color had been used for many years in the shipping industry to help objects stand out. Morrow also felt that its brightness would complement the beautiful landscape of the bay area.

questions.passage: When San Francisco's famous Golden Gate Bridge was being designed in the mid-1930s, the United States Navy (A)[proposed / rejected] colors that would have given the landmark a much different feel. The Navy suggested that it be painted yellow with black stripes to (B)[avoid / cause] any accidents with ships. However, these colors might well remind people of industrial caution tape. Of course, nobody outside the Navy wanted to paint the bridge with those colors. In the end, architect Irving Morrow decided to use "International Orange," as it was both visible and pleasing to the eye. The color had been used for many years in the shipping industry to help objects stand out. Morrow also felt that its brightness would (C)[complement / undermine] the beautiful landscape of the bay area.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) proposed=제안했다, (B) avoid=피하다, (C) complement=보완하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① proposed — avoid — complement: 원문 일치. 해군이 색상을 제안했고(proposed), 사고를 피하기 위해(avoid), 밝기가 만 지역의 풍경을 보완할(complement) 것이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② rejected — avoid — complement: (A) rejected(거부했다)는 proposed(제안했다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ proposed — cause — complement: (B) cause(야기하다)는 avoid(피하다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ proposed — avoid — undermine: (C) undermine(훼손하다)은 complement(보완하다)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: Navy proposed colors / to avoid accidents / complement the beautiful landscape

questions.passage: When San Francisco's famous Golden Gate Bridge was being designed in the mid-1930s, the United States Navy proposed colors that would have given the landmark a much different feel. Of course, nobody outside the Navy wanted to paint the bridge with those colors. In the end, architect Irving Morrow decided to use "International Orange," as it was both (A)[visible / hidden] and (B)[pleasing / harmful] to the eye. The color had been used for many years in the shipping industry to help objects (C)[stand out / blend in]. Morrow also felt that its brightness would complement the beautiful landscape of the bay area.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) visible=눈에 보이는, (B) pleasing=기분 좋은, (C) stand out=두드러지다
det.analysis:
❌ ① hidden — pleasing — stand out: (A) hidden(숨겨진)은 visible(눈에 보이는)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② visible — harmful — stand out: (B) harmful(해로운)은 pleasing(기분 좋은)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ visible — pleasing — blend in: (C) blend in(섞여 들다)은 stand out(두드러지다)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ④ visible — pleasing — stand out: 원문 일치. 눈에 잘 보이고(visible), 보기 좋고(pleasing), 물체가 두드러지도록(stand out) 돕는다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: both visible and pleasing to the eye / help objects stand out

questions.passage: When San Francisco's famous Golden Gate Bridge was being designed in the mid-1930s, the United States Navy proposed colors that would have given the (A)[landmark / obstacle] a much different feel. The Navy suggested that it be painted yellow with black stripes to avoid any accidents with ships. However, these colors might well (B)[remind / prevent] people of industrial caution tape. Of course, nobody outside the Navy wanted to paint the bridge with those colors. In the end, architect Irving Morrow decided to use "International Orange," as it was both visible and pleasing to the eye. The color had been used for many years in the shipping industry to help objects stand out. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) landmark=명소/랜드마크, (B) remind=상기시키다, (C) brightness=밝기
det.analysis:
❌ ① landmark — remind — darkness: (C) darkness(어둠)는 brightness(밝기)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② obstacle — remind — brightness: (A) obstacle(장애물)은 landmark(명소)와 다른 의미로 부적절
❌ ③ landmark — prevent — brightness: (B) prevent(막다)는 remind(상기시키다)와 다른 의미로 부적절
✅ ④ landmark — remind — brightness: 원문 일치. 명소에(landmark) 다른 느낌, 산업용 테이프를 상기시키고(remind), 밝기가(brightness) 풍경을 보완한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: the landmark / remind people of industrial caution tape / its brightness

questions.passage: When San Francisco's famous Golden Gate Bridge was being designed in the mid-1930s, the United States Navy ①<u>proposed</u> colors that would have given the landmark a much different feel. The Navy suggested that it be painted yellow with black stripes to ②<u>avoid</u> any accidents with ships. However, these colors might well ③<u>distract</u> people of industrial caution tape. Of course, nobody outside the Navy wanted to paint the bridge with those colors. In the end, architect Irving Morrow decided to use "International Orange," as it was both visible and pleasing to the eye. The color had been used for many years in the shipping industry to help objects stand out. Morrow also felt that its brightness would ④<u>complement</u> the beautiful landscape of the bay area.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 이 색상들은 사람들에게 산업용 주의 테이프를 '상기시킬' 수 있다는 문맥. distract(주의를 산만하게 하다)는 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① proposed — 원문 일치. 해군이 색상을 제안했다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② avoid — 원문 일치. 선박 사고를 피하기 위해라는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ distract — 원문은 remind(상기시키다). distract(산만하게 하다)로 바꾸면 '이 색상이 사람들을 산업용 테이프에서 산만하게 할 수 있다'가 되어 의미 부자연스러움 ←정답
❌ ④ complement — 원문 일치. 밝기가 풍경을 보완한다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: remind people of ~ = ~을 상기시키다. 노란색+검은 줄무늬 → 주의 테이프 연상이 핵심

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: International Orange는 눈에 잘 '보이고' 보기 좋다는 맥락. invisible(보이지 않는)은 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① designed — 원문 일치. 다리가 설계되고 있었다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② invisible — 원문은 visible(눈에 보이는). invisible(보이지 않는)로 바꾸면 '보이지 않고 보기 좋다'가 되어 다리 색상 선택 이유와 모순 ←정답
❌ ③ shipping — 원문 일치. 해운 산업에서 사용되었다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ beautiful — 원문 일치. 만 지역의 아름다운 풍경이라는 맥락에 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 그 색은 물체가 '두드러지도록' 돕는 데 쓰였다는 문맥. fade away(사라지다)는 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① famous — 원문 일치. 유명한 금문교라는 맥락에 적절

❌ ③ decided — 원문 일치. Morrow가 결정했다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ fade away — 원문은 stand out(두드러지다). fade away(사라지다)로 바꾸면 '물체가 사라지도록 돕는 색'이 되어 해운 산업에서의 가시성 목적과 모순 ←정답
det.tip: stand out(두드러지다) ↔ fade away(사라지다) — 가시성의 핵심 대조

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: complement=보완하다 (밝기가 만 지역의 아름다운 풍경을 보완할 것이라 느꼈다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① avoid: avoid(피하다)는 사고 방지와 관련, 풍경 보완과 무관

❌ ④ proposed: proposed(제안하다)는 해군의 행위이지 밝기의 기능이 아님

✅ ② (A) 촉감이 ~하다 — (B) ~라고 느끼다/생각하다: (A)는 천의 촉감을 묘사, (B)는 Morrow의 판단/의견을 표현. 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 촉감이 ~하다 — (B) 감정을 느끼다: (B)는 감정이 아닌 판단/의견
❌ ④ (A) 만져보다 — (B) 촉감이 ~하다: 두 의미 모두 부적절
det.tip: felt: ① (촉감) ~하게 느껴지다 ② (판단) ~라고 생각하다/느끼다

questions.passage: When San Francisco's famous Golden Gate Bridge was being designed in the mid-1930s, the United States Navy proposed colors that would have given the landmark a much different feel. The Navy suggested that it be painted yellow with black stripes to avoid any accidents with ships. However, these colors might well remind people of industrial caution tape. Of course, nobody outside the Navy wanted to paint the bridge with those colors. In the end, architect Irving Morrow decided to use "International Orange," as it was __________. The color had been used for many years in the shipping industry to help objects stand out. Morrow also felt that its brightness would complement the beautiful landscape of the bay area.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: International Orange를 선택한 이유: 눈에 잘 보이면서도 보기 좋았기 때문
det.analysis:
✅ ① both visible and pleasing to the eye: 원문 일치. International Orange가 눈에 잘 보이면서도 보기에 좋다는 선택 이유에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② yellow with black stripes to avoid: 이는 해군의 제안이지 Morrow의 선택 이유가 아님
❌ ③ famous and different from the landmark: 유명하고 다르다는 맥락은 색상 특성 설명이 아님
❌ ④ painted to remind people of caution: 주의 테이프 연상은 부정적 이유이므로 선택 이유와 반대
det.tip: as it was both visible and pleasing to the eye — International Orange 선택의 두 가지 이유
